verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's JavaScript scenario feature explicitly supports clicking (`wait_for_and_click`) and filling forms (`fill`) before returning HTML, and cookies can be passed to maintain sessions, which together enable interacting with a page to reach gated content. However, docs never explicitly address login-wall workflows or session persistence across multiple scrape calls, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this works for authenticated content. Missing for 10: explicit login-wall example/tutorial, evidence of session persistence across separate API calls, independent corroboration of successful login-gated scraping.
